verdict.rationale: Codegen is presented entirely as a cloud-hosted agent platform (SaaS API, SDK, CLI, GitHub/Slack apps, sandbox execution) with no evidence of self-hosted deployment options such as Docker images, Helm charts, on-prem installers, or VM deployment guides; the CLI even wraps local Claude Code but reports telemetry back to Codegen's cloud, implying dependency on the hosted service rather than local/self-hosted infrastructure.
